title: Mélenchon Is Right About France’s Debt
gist: Yanis Varoufakis argues that French centrists and the Banque de France governor are pushing deeper austerity that will inflame social tensions and choke investment, while dismissing alternatives like Mélenchon's debt proposal as nonsense. He warns this leaves the far right as the only electable rebellion and makes France's public debt Europe's next fault line.

insights.claim: Varoufakis argues that the deteriorating state of France's public schools, which triggered nationwide demonstrations, is a symptom of chronic austerity.
insights.speaker: Project Syndicate
insights.so_what: Social unrest rooted in underinvestment raises political risk premia on French assets.
insights.quote: The sorry state of France’s public schools, which sparked angry demonstrations across the country, was a symptom of chronic austerity.

insights.claim: Banque de France governor Emmanuel Moulin is calling for large budget cuts to avoid France being gradually strangled by rising interest rates.
insights.speaker: Project Syndicate
insights.so_what: Central bank pressure for fiscal consolidation signals tighter French fiscal policy and concern over OAT yields.
insights.quote: is calling for large budget cuts to avert the “risk of being gradually strangled by rising interest rates.”

insights.claim: Varoufakis predicts that deeper budget cuts in France would further inflame social tensions and cause much-needed investment to disappear.
insights.speaker: Project Syndicate
insights.so_what: Austerity could depress French growth and capex while raising unrest-driven volatility.
insights.quote: If that happens, social tensions will be further inflamed and desperately needed investment will vanish.

insights.claim: Varoufakis contends that when centrists dismiss every sensible alternative to severe austerity as nonsense, they leave voters with only one electable form of rebellion, which the far right supplies.
insights.speaker: Project Syndicate
insights.so_what: Implies rising odds of a far-right electoral win in France, a key tail risk for euro-area spreads.
insights.quote: they leave voters only one electable rebellion on offer, and the far right is happy to supply it
insights.locator: When, in the name of moderation

insights.claim: Varoufakis argues Mélenchon's debt proposal for France is sensible and has been wrongly rejected by European elites.
insights.speaker: Project Syndicate
insights.so_what: Signals that left-populist debt restructuring/swap ideas may gain intellectual cover, relevant to French sovereign debt outlook.
insights.locator: Mélenchon Is Right About France’s Debt

insights.claim: With Germany confronting deindustrialization and surging far-right support, Varoufakis sees France's public debt becoming Europe's next fault line.
insights.speaker: Project Syndicate
insights.so_what: Points to French sovereign debt as a potential epicenter of the next euro-area stress episode.
insights.quote: France’s public debt is shaping up as Europe’s next fault line
